scope: Thin intact normal-incidence cover comparator. Primary projectile transmission and energy removal only; no gas impermeability, structural integrity, track-to-hole conversion, secondary electron retention, thermal response or stopping-to-retention inference. Carbon uses current updated model; aluminium uses archived analytic H/He and measured CNO stopping plus ZBL. Aluminium density2300kg/m3 is the earlier collection-layer assumption; support/phase compatibility remains separate.
incoming_gas_scope: Atomic-mass kinetic energy in pellet frame, NIST graphite stopping. These sub-MeV gas impacts differ from outgoing source ions; full energy retention remains an upper deposition assumption.
NRT_scope: Total elastic recoil transfer proxy atEd25/40, not surviving defects, holes or failed gas sealing. Ionization-track overlap alone does not imply perforation.
